Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 后训练与对齐主题reinforcement learning
Siyuan Huang, Pengyu Cheng, Haotian Liu, Tao Chen, Yihao Liu, Jingwei Ni et al.
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 这项工作把技能库作为开放式自进化的验证接口：相比只在固定环境中训练或依赖难以核验的自生成任务，它让模型通过可验证执行获得反馈，同时保持任务分布的扩展性。对研究工具调用、推理和强化学习后训练的读者而言，关键价值在于用提议者、求解器和技能控制器形成持续自博弈，并据称提升已有能力模型、甚至扭转初始不对齐模型的表现。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 23）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

自进化训练需要在广泛任务探索与可靠奖励验证之间取得平衡。

02
方法

提议者依据动态采样的技能生成挑战任务，求解器搜索解法，技能控制器利用执行反馈更新并扩展技能库。

03
差异

方法以技能提供场景级深度验证，并通过技能间动态路由维持开放式任务多样性。

04
证据

论文报告其在工具调用和推理基准上持续提升有能力骨干模型，并改善初始不对齐模型的表现。

摘要

大型语言模型训练正从人工设计和标注转向基于交互的自我进化，但现有方法难以同时兼顾任务多样性与验证可靠性：环境绑定方法反馈准确却局限于狭窄领域，开放式自生成方法任务范围广却容易让误导性奖励污染训练循环。本文提出技能自博弈，通过提议者、求解器和动态技能控制器组成强化学习循环，使技能在可验证执行与开放式任务探索之间协同进化；在工具调用和推理基准上的实验表明，该方法能够持续提高已有能力模型的性能上限，并促成初始不对齐模型的显著表现转变。

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 后训练与对齐主题reinforcement learning
Jian Hu, Huiying Li, Hao Zhang, Binfeng Xu, Yifan Zhang, Shaokun Zhang et al.
high · 2026-07-22

为什么值得看 这项工作直接降低智能体强化学习中修改估计器、采样流程和训练阶段的工程成本：研究者可以在一个端到端可追踪的原生框架中改算法，同时覆盖多模态策略和混合专家策略，并保持异步训练中的令牌、策略版本与模型语义一致。与匹配协议下的主流分布式栈相比，作者声称其性能在统计上相当，因此它尤其适合需要频繁迭代强化学习算法的研究团队。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 15）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

智能体强化学习中的算法改动需要同时协调训练器、分布式后端、采样流程和多个训练阶段。

02
方法

该方法使用紧凑的原生深度学习框架，以一个异步循环统一智能体执行、采样和策略训练。

03
差异

框架把智能体实现为普通程序，并显式保持生成令牌、策略版本和模型语义的一致性。

04
证据

在匹配的全异步协议下，作者报告其性能与基于主流大规模训练栈的系统在统计上相当。

摘要

智能体强化学习研究经常修改算法、估计器、训练阶段和采样方案，而主流框架通常要求这些改动穿过训练器、分布式后端和采样流程胶水代码，增加研究者每次迭代的成本。该工作介绍了一个原生支持深度学习框架的训练框架：它通过紧凑且易于整体理解的代码，使算法流程能够端到端追踪和修改；智能体是普通程序，单个异步循环可训练多模态策略和混合专家策略，并且不会使用智能体未生成的令牌进行训练，同时保持令牌、策略版本和模型语义一致。在匹配的全异步协议下，该框架的统计性能与基于主流大规模训练栈的系统相当，并提供开源实现、训练配方和容器。

Integrated Order Dispatching and Routing for Last-Mile Pickup via Deep Reinforcement Learning

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 后训练与对齐主题reinforcement learning
Yida Xu, Zhaofang Mao, Yuheng Miao, Jiaxin Zhang, Yiting Sun
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 这项工作适合关注组合优化与强化学习落地的研究者：它不把订单分派和路径规划割裂处理，也不直接依赖大规模端到端学习，而是用学习得到的路径规划器为实时分派启发式筛选候选配送员，从而兼顾决策耦合、稀疏奖励和大规模实例的求解速度。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

问题是在大规模、动态末端取件场景中联合决定订单分派与配送路径。

02
方法

方法用动态残差图注意力网络和前瞻式配送员个性化解码器学习路径规划器，再以该规划器结合局部搜索执行分派。

03
差异

区别在于以路径规划器提供近最优候选评价，替代完全端到端学习或将分派与路径规划完全分离。

04
证据

证据来自菜鸟物流真实数据上的离线评估和在线滚动时域仿真，结果显示其解质量和求解时间优于基准方法。

摘要

近年来，末端取件业务日益复杂，物流平台需要快速而准确地决策。该问题包含两个紧密耦合的过程，即订单分派与路径规划；分开求解会忽略二者的相互影响，而在大规模、规模变化的实例上进行完全端到端学习又可能因奖励稀疏而不稳定且成本高。论文将学习得到的路径规划器与实时分派启发式方法结合：路径子问题采用动态残差图注意力网络编码器和前瞻式配送员个性化解码器，分派子问题采用由路径规划器引导并结合局部搜索的启发式方法。基于菜鸟物流真实数据集的离线评估和在线滚动时域仿真表明，该方法在解质量和求解时间方面优于其他基准，可支持实时、大规模末端取件优化。

Anduel Mehmeti, Gabriella Gigante, Salvatore Venticinque
cites 2 · medium · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 这项工作把强化学习决策解释推进到空中交通管制这一安全关键场景，重点检查显著性图能否揭示智能体为何选择避开禁飞区的航线。它适合关注可解释强化学习、人机协作和高风险部署的研究者，但目前仍是简化环境中的初步验证，尚不足以说明方法适用于真实管制系统。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

研究深度强化学习在安全关键的空中交通管制场景中如何提供可理解的决策依据。

02
方法

在简化的空中交通管制环境中训练强化学习智能体，并通过显著性图分析输入特征对动作选择的影响。

03
差异

工作将强化学习解释技术用于航线避开禁飞区的决策，而不是只评估智能体是否获得较高回报。

04
证据

摘要仅说明完成了初步测试床和显著性分析，没有报告定量性能、解释准确性或真实管制数据结果。

摘要

为推动人工智能进入医疗、自动驾驶和航空等安全关键环境，并实现更高程度的自动化与顺畅的人机协作，建立对人工智能系统的信任十分重要，而信任与系统的可解释性密切相关。本文在简化的空中交通管制环境中训练强化学习智能体，使其选择避开禁飞区的备选航线，并使用显著性图作为初步解释方法，以揭示最影响智能体决策的输入特征。

为什么值得看 这项工作把智能体记忆从单纯的存储检索问题扩展为涵盖记忆、作用域、预取、遗忘和上下文压缩的完整运行时管理问题。对构建长对话、多租户和工具密集型智能体的研究者而言，它提供了比每轮累积历史或简单摘要更系统的设计框架，并声称在保持信息准确性的同时将上下文成本控制为线性增长。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 15）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

工作针对对话历史、工具输出和组织级信息不断挤占智能体上下文并导致记忆遗漏的问题。

02
方法

方法将上下文生命周期拆为架构设计、摄取、作用域、预判以及压缩与整合五项基本能力。

03
差异

它区别于把记忆仅视为存储检索的做法，并强调按数据类型选存储、保留来源和组织层级管理。

04
证据

参考实现据称在长记忆评测上达到百分之九十二，在洛科莫评测上达到百分之九十三点二。

摘要

生产环境中智能体的失败往往不是因为推理能力不足，而是因为无法管理推理上下文，包括对话历史、大型提示词、工具定义和不断膨胀的工具输出。本文将这一问题定义为智能体上下文管理，分解为架构设计、信息摄取、作用域管理、需求预判以及压缩与整合五项基本能力，并指出朴素累积会使标记成本随对话长度呈平方增长，粗略摘要虽能降为线性成本却会造成准确率骤降，只有经过验证的压缩才能在线性成本下保持信息保真度；文中参考实现据称在长记忆评测和洛科莫评测上分别达到百分之九十二和百分之九十三点二。

Darshan Tank, Baran Nama
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 这项研究提醒智能体研究者，程序技能的价值不能只看平均成功率：技能可能通过上下文渗透、输入落地方式被替代、以及输出验证被抑制而制造回归。对办公自动化智能体而言，优先改进输入理解与结果核验，可能比继续增加程序步骤更能提升可靠性；近六千次运行显示，强技能主要是少造成回归，而不是带来更多新增成功。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

研究技能加入后为何会让原本成功的任务失败，以及这些回归与持续失败的来源。

02
方法

在两个办公自动化基准和三种模型调用栈上运行近六千次带技能与不带技能的对照实验，并分析执行轨迹。

03
差异

方法把总体效果拆成新增成功、回归和残余失败，并区分技能描述渗透、落地替代和验证替代三种回归模式。

04
证据

研究发现高表现技能主要通过减少回归取胜，且许多回归和持续失败可由更好的输入落地与输出验证恢复。

摘要

研究者在两个办公自动化基准和三种模型调用栈上的近六千次运行中，同时比较带技能和不带技能的智能体表现，将“原本成功、加入技能后失败”定义为回归，将两种条件下都失败定义为残余失败。结果表明，技能导致的回归相当显著，主要原因包括技能描述渗透、输入落地被程序替代和输出验证被程序抑制；现有技能过度强调程序指导，却不足以支持落地与验证，而许多回归和持续失败可以通过改进这两部分来恢复。

high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 这项工作针对统一多模态模型中语义表示与生成潜变量不匹配的问题，在不增加序列长度和注意力开销的前提下，把视觉变换器特征与变分自编码器特征合并到同一连续词元空间，并用聚焦回归损失修正两类特征的优化失衡；对希望用单一视觉接口兼顾理解和图像生成的模型研究者尤其有参考价值。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

连续统一模型通常分别使用面向理解的语义特征和面向生成的低层潜变量，导致潜空间不匹配。

02
方法

方法在同一词元网格上拼接视觉变换器与变分自编码器特征，并用适配流匹配的聚焦回归损失提高大误差变分自编码器维度的权重。

03
差异

与离散共享码本或两个分离的连续表示不同，该方法保持序列长度不变，并显式平衡两种表示的联合优化。

04
证据

论文报告其在图像网络数据集上相较朴素均方误差损失最高获得百分之十点五七的生成保真度指标增益，并改善重建保真度。

摘要

统一多模态模型希望使用支持多模态理解和图像生成的共享视觉词元空间。论文将同一词元网格上的视觉变换器特征与变分自编码器特征按通道拼接，形成序列长度不变的统一连续词元空间；针对扩散变换器难以拟合变分自编码器潜变量分布的问题，论文分析了频率偏差、内在维度以及条件相关与条件无关不确定性三类异质性，并将聚焦回归目标改用于流匹配，以提高大误差潜变量维度的权重。在图像网络数据集上，该方法相较朴素均方误差损失在无分类器自由引导时最高带来百分之十点五七的生成保真度指标增益，同时在多模态理解基准上保持竞争力并改善重建保真度。

为什么值得看 这项工作把事故语义概念从事后解释提升为碰撞预警模型的中间证据：概念轨迹同时引导空间注意力、时间注意力和风险预测。对于需要更早预警且必须说明风险来源的自动驾驶研究者，它提供了比不透明特征模型和低保真后验解释更紧密的可解释建模路径。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有碰撞预警模型通常难以解释其跟踪的风险因素，且事后解释可能与真实预测过程不一致。

02
方法

方法从事故叙述生成风险概念，用视觉语言相似度将概念对齐到视频帧，再形成随时间演化的概念轨迹。

03
差异

风险概念不是附加解释，而是直接控制空间注意力、时间注意力和风险预测的动态中间证据。

04
证据

在三个基准上，方法相较强基线提升了预警准确性和提前性，并提供稀疏、语义对应的概念证据。

摘要

自动驾驶碰撞预警不仅需要准确且提前的警报，还需要解释模型跟踪了哪些风险因素以及风险如何随时间演化。该方法从事故叙述中提取有领域依据的风险概念，通过视觉语言相似度将其与视频帧对齐，并组织为动态变化的概念轨迹；这些轨迹显式提供风险证据，指导空间注意力、时间注意力和预警预测。三个基准上的实验表明，该方法相较强基线持续提升预警准确性和提前性，同时产生稀疏且具有语义依据的概念证据。

为什么值得看 该内容与AI 算法的当前追踪方向相关，建议结合原文判断实际价值。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 4）
代码
摘要

Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents, but reliable agentic behavior requires more than next-token prediction. At inference time, it is preferred that an agent can decide whether to proceed with its current reasoning, defer to a stronger model, request additional information, invoke external tools, or abstain under the given setup. Existing approaches address these decisions through prompt-level routing, external orchestration, or task-specific fine-tuning, which primarily rely on input-side signals, and are often costly and difficult to maintain as model backbones evolve. We ask whether such control decisions can be inferred directly from a model's latent generation process. We introduce Multi-Head Latent Control, a lightweight layer that reads hidden-state trajectories from a frozen LLM or VLM to produce deployment-time control signals. A Capability Head predicts whether the current model can solve the instance or should defer to a stronger collaborator, while a Resolution Head predicts appropriate resolution decision Clarification, Tool Use, Abstention, or Direct Answering. Both heads are trained only on latent traces from the same frozen LLM backbone, enabling post hoc adaptation without modifying the model. Across language and vision-language settings, Multi-Head Latent Control consistently improves the quality-cost tradeoff of multi-model systems, enabling early handoff from partial generations and more accurate intervention decisions. In routed execution (small + large model), it reduces large-model usage by up to 90.7 percent on AndroidWorld and 27-53 percent on average across benchmarks, while retaining most of large-model performance. Additionally, the learned control signals improve tool-use decision quality, yielding up to +158 percent relative score gain and 65.5 percent fewer missed-required tool calls.

摘要

We introduce time-reversed imaging, a new paradigm that infers what just happened in a scene from fading multimodal traces. Instead of extrapolating or interpolating video frames, our goal is to infer past human-environment interactions from residual physical imprints observable in thermal, ultraviolet, and visible spectra. To study this problem, we present TRACE-HEI, the first proof-of-concept dataset for time-reversed imaging, containing synchronized tri-modal video sequences of actions such as sitting, touching, moving objects, and liquid spills, captured across diverse materials and recorded up to three minutes after contact. To establish the benchmark, we propose a multimodal inference approach that extracts structured textual descriptions of detected traces and uses them to constrain a vision-language-guided diffusion model for reconstructing plausible past frames. Experiments show that inferring recent events from fading traces is challenging but feasible when complementary modalities reduce solution ambiguity. This work defines the first computational and experimental foundation for time-reversed imaging, bridging vision, physics, and generative reasoning, and opening new directions for scene understanding beyond instantaneous observation.

摘要

Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents, but reliable agentic behavior requires more than next-token prediction. At inference time, it is preferred that an agent can decide whether to proceed with its current reasoning, defer to a stronger model, request additional information, invoke external tools, or abstain under the given setup. Existing approaches address these decisions through prompt-level routing, external orchestration, or task-specific fine-tuning, which primarily rely on input-side signals, and are often costly and difficult to maintain as model backbones evolve. We ask whether such control decisions can be inferred directly from a model's latent generation process. We introduce Multi-Head Latent Control, a lightweight layer that reads hidden-state trajectories from a frozen LLM or VLM to produce deployment-time control signals. A Capability Head predicts whether the current model can solve the instance or should defer to a stronger collaborator, while a Resolution Head predicts appropriate resolution decision Clarification, Tool Use, Abstention, or Direct Answering. Both heads are trained only on latent traces from the same frozen LLM backbone, enabling post hoc adaptation without modifying the model. Across language and vision-language settings, Multi-Head Latent Control consistently improves the quality-cost tradeoff of multi-model systems, enabling early handoff from partial generations and more accurate intervention decisions. In routed execution (small + large model), it reduces large-model usage by up to 90.7 percent on AndroidWorld and 27-53 percent on average across benchmarks, while retaining most of large-model performance. Additionally, the learned control signals improve tool-use decision quality, yielding up to +158 percent relative score gain and 65.5 percent fewer missed-required tool calls.

摘要

We introduce time-reversed imaging, a new paradigm that infers what just happened in a scene from fading multimodal traces. Instead of extrapolating or interpolating video frames, our goal is to infer past human-environment interactions from residual physical imprints observable in thermal, ultraviolet, and visible spectra. To study this problem, we present TRACE-HEI, the first proof-of-concept dataset for time-reversed imaging, containing synchronized tri-modal video sequences of actions such as sitting, touching, moving objects, and liquid spills, captured across diverse materials and recorded up to three minutes after contact. To establish the benchmark, we propose a multimodal inference approach that extracts structured textual descriptions of detected traces and uses them to constrain a vision-language-guided diffusion model for reconstructing plausible past frames. Experiments show that inferring recent events from fading traces is challenging but feasible when complementary modalities reduce solution ambiguity. Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Post-Training and AlignmentTopicreinforcement learning
Siyuan Huang, Pengyu Cheng, Haotian Liu, Tao Chen, Yihao Liu, Jingwei Ni et al.
high · 2026-07-24

Why it matters This work treats a skill library as a verifiable interface for open-ended self-evolution: unlike fixed environments or weakly checked self-generated tasks, it supplies execution feedback while allowing the task distribution to expand. For researchers in tool use, reasoning, and reinforcement-learning post-training, the important idea is a continuous self-play loop among a proposer, solver, and skill controller, which is reported to raise capable backbones and turn around initially misaligned models.

Source signalsarXiv indexedHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 23)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Self-evolution must balance broad task exploration with reliable reward verification.

02
Method

A proposer generates skill-conditioned challenges, a solver searches for solutions, and a skill controller updates and expands the skill library from execution feedback.

03
Difference

Skills provide deep scenario-level verification while dynamic routing across skills preserves open-ended task diversity.

04
Evidence

The paper reports consistent gains on tool-use and reasoning benchmarks, including improved behavior from initially misaligned models.

Abstract

LLM training is shifting from manual design and annotation to interaction-driven self-evolution. However, existing self-evolutionary methods face a fundamental dilemma between task diversity and verification reliability: environment-bound methods obtain precise feedback but confine learning to narrow domains, while open-ended self-generation broadens the task space but lacks reliable verification, allowing misleading rewards to pollute the training loop. We identify agent skills as a powerful middle ground to reconcile this tension: each skill ensures deep, verifiable execution in a specific scenario, while dynamic routing across skills maintains open-ended task variety. Leveraging this insight, we introduce Skill Self-Play (Skill-SP), a co-evolutionary framework comprising a proposer, a solver, and a dynamic skill controller. Orchestrated via a reinforcement learning loop, these components co-evolve in a continuous self-play loop: the proposer generates challenging tasks conditioned on dynamically sampled skills; the solver explores candidate solutions to push its capability boundaries; and the skill controller collects execution feedback to update and expand the skill library. This interactive co-evolution effectively bridges the gap between structured verification and open-ended exploration. Empirical evaluations on tool-use and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that Skill-SP, serving as a robust evolution engine, consistently pushes the performance ceiling of competent backbones while catalyzing striking turnarounds for initially misaligned models. Our code is available at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/skill-self-play.

Molt: A Scalable PyTorch-Native Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Post-Training and AlignmentTopicreinforcement learning
Jian Hu, Huiying Li, Hao Zhang, Binfeng Xu, Yifan Zhang, Shaokun Zhang et al.
high · 2026-07-22

Why it matters This work targets a real bottleneck in agentic reinforcement learning: every change to estimators, rollout schemes, or training stages can otherwise propagate through trainers, distributed backends, and glue code. Its compact PyTorch-native design supports end-to-end algorithm changes for multimodal and mixture-of-experts policies while preserving token, policy-version, and model-semantic consistency; under a matched fully asynchronous protocol, the authors report statistical comparability with a large-scale Megatron-based stack.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 15)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Agentic reinforcement learning changes often require coordinated edits across trainers, distributed backends, rollout logic, and pipeline stages.

02
Method

Molt uses a compact PyTorch-native codebase with one asynchronous loop for agent execution, rollout, and policy training.

03
Difference

It treats the agent as an ordinary program and explicitly maintains consistency across generated tokens, policy versions, and model semantics.

04
Evidence

Under a matched fully asynchronous protocol, the authors report statistical comparability with a Megatron-based training stack.

Abstract

Agentic reinforcement learning research is constant algorithm modification, new estimators, new pipeline stages, new rollout schemes, and in mainstream frameworks each change threads through layers of trainer, distributed backend, and rollout glue: the cost lands on the researcher at every iteration. Molt is a PyTorch-native training framework built to keep that cost small: a codebase compact and clean enough for a researcher to hold in their head, and for an AI coding assistant to read and reason about in its entirety, so the algorithm flow can be traced and changed end to end. The agent is an ordinary program, and one asynchronous loop trains multimodal and mixture-of-experts policies while never training on a token it did not generate, consistent in tokens, policy versions, and model semantics. Leanness does not cost performance: under a matched, fully asynchronous protocol, Molt is statistically comparable to a state-of-the-art Megatron-based stack. Molt is open source and provides recipes and containers at https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/labs-molt.

We outline a three-source architecture instantiating this principle: role-based ceilings, a task-context classifier, and policy-derived combination prohibitions creating a layered proactive defense against LLM agent misalignment and misuse cases. The architecture supports both enforcing and observe-only deployment; the latter records agent permission requests inconsistent with task context, producing a behavioral signal usable in misalignment research. As a first step toward evaluating this architecture, we contribute a synthetic dataset of 600 enterprise task prompts grounded in a multi-department company policy, labeled with minimum required permissions across a 15-permission tool-based taxonomy that maps directly to deployable credentials or enforceable guardrails. The dataset is constructed via a two-pass pipeline that separates prompt generation from permission labeling to avoid circularity, and is validated against a 60-record/688 decisions human-reviewed sample (Cohen's $κ= 0.917$ pre-review and $κ= 0.967$ post-review). Iterating between dataset and policy reduced ceiling violations from 46 to 3, a 93% reduction. This shows that synthetic prompt generation can drive policy refinement when the two are developed together. The dataset, environment specification, and generation pipeline are released to support evaluation of dynamic scoping mechanisms.

01
论文 / 重点关注

Mage-Flow: An Efficient Native-Resolution Foundation Model for Image Generation and Editing

分类方向编译器、内核与硬件 / GPU/加速器内核主题CUDA / kernel optimization
Xinjie Zhang, Peng Zhang, Shicheng Zheng, Jinghao Guo, Zhaoyang Jia, Yifei Shen et al.
medium · 2026-07-21

为什么值得看 这项工作展示了如何把轻量级视觉编码器、原生分辨率打包和堆栈级 CUDA 内核融合一起设计，以降低高分辨率图像生成的训练与推理成本。对负责视觉生成系统优化的研究者而言，文中声称训练吞吐提升约二点五倍，并在单张英伟达 A100 上将一千零二十四平方分辨率生成和编辑压到零点五九秒与一秒零二，提供了可参考的端到端系统协同路径。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 72）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

大规模视觉生成器的训练、微调和部署成本较高，尤其是在高分辨率场景下。

02
方法

系统结合一步扩散式潜变量编码器、原生分辨率多模态扩散变换器、整流流匹配和 CUDA 内核融合。

03
差异

相较于单独扩大模型规模，该方法联合设计编码器、主干网络和系统实现，并提供基础、对齐和快速推理变体。

04
证据

文中报告标记化成本降低一个数量级以上、训练吞吐提升约二点五倍，并在单张英伟达 A100 上达到生成零点五九秒和编辑一秒零二秒。

摘要

本文介绍了 Mage-Flow，一个面向文本生成图像和指令式图像编辑的紧凑型四十亿参数生成系统，由轻量高保真潜变量编码器 Mage-VAE 和采用整流流匹配训练的原生分辨率多模态扩散变换器共同构成。Mage-VAE 通过一步扩散式编解码与锚点潜变量正则化，在保持强大公开潜变量编码器重建质量的同时，将标记化成本降低一个数量级以上；结合原生分辨率打包和堆栈级 CUDA 内核融合，系统将端到端训练吞吐提升约二点五倍。该模型家族还包含基础版、强化学习对齐版和快速版，快速版本可通过少步蒸馏实现四步推理；在单张英伟达 A100 上，快速版生成一张一千零二十四平方图像需零点五九秒，编辑需一秒零二秒，同时保持较小的内存占用。

Unified Static-Dynamic Pruning for Efficient LLM Inference

cites 2 · high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 这项工作直接面向大语言模型服务中的解码瓶颈，把永久稀疏与输入自适应稀疏放进同一套存储格式和图形处理器内核中，覆盖预填充与解码两个阶段。若其报告的平均加速和更高稀疏度能够复现，它可为推理引擎开发者提供一种比单独静态剪枝或动态剪枝更兼顾带宽、计算强度和性能功耗的实现路径。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

静态剪枝不能适应输入，而动态剪枝会给大语言模型图形处理器推理带来运行时不规则性。

02
方法

方法采用统一的分块列式位图压缩格式，并配套支持激活跳过的稀疏矩阵向量乘内核和面向预填充的张量核心稀疏矩阵乘内核。

03
差异

它不是分别处理两类稀疏性，而是让同一格式和内核设计同时协调永久权重稀疏与输入相关激活稀疏。

04
证据

在面向推理优化的图形处理器上，文中报告相较稀疏推理框架平均一点二四至一点三七倍加速、最高两点五一倍加速，并在困惑度相当时提高最高百分之二十五的稀疏度。

摘要

大语言模型的自回归解码受低计算强度和带宽受限内核影响，现有静态剪枝缺乏自适应性，而动态剪枝会引入运行时不规则性。本文提出一种统一稀疏推理框架，将非结构化静态剪枝与输入自适应动态剪枝结合，并共同设计分块列式位图压缩格式及两类图形处理器内核，分别服务于解码和预填充计算；在面向推理优化的图形处理器上，框架相较稀疏推理系统平均加速百分之二十四至百分之三十七，最高达到两点五一倍，在困惑度相当时支持最高百分之二十五的额外稀疏度。

Junsong Chen, Jincheng Yu, Yitong Li, Shuchen Xue, Haozhe Liu, Jingyu Xin et al.
high · 2026-07-23

为什么值得看 这项工作把视频扩散模型的长序列注意力和单卡推理优化放在同一条路径上：在全注意力成本随视频时长快速增长时，仅保留四分之一的软最大值注意力锚点，并结合编译、缓存和稀疏注意力优化。文中报告单张英伟达高端数据中心显卡上，七百二十像素视频的编译前向比匹配的全软最大值基线快三点二倍，完整优化栈又带来三点五八倍加速，适合关注长视频生成服务和单卡部署的基础设施研究者。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 34）
方法解读
01
问题

视频扩散变换器中的全软最大值注意力会带来随序列长度二次增长的计算成本，而纯线性注意力缺少完整的标记交互能力。

02
方法

方法以门控线性注意力承担主要混合，并按四比一比例插入门控软最大值注意力锚点，再用块级注意力残差向后续线性层传递块摘要。

03
差异

模型从头学习这种混合结构，而不是把预训练的全软最大值模型线性化，并通过注意力残差复用锚点表示。

04
证据

低分辨率代理实验将四分之一软最大值注意力确定为质量与效率的折中点，完整实验报告四百八十像素下八十四点三零的基准分数和单卡十三点二秒的四十步采样时间。

摘要

本文介绍一种统一架构的视频扩散变换器，采用混合线性注意力与注意力残差，在五十亿和一百四十亿参数规模上实现，并宣称可在单张显卡上生成最高七百二十像素视频，同时保持接近全软最大值视频扩散变换器的质量和线性注意力的长序列扩展性。该方法以四比一的线性注意力与软最大值注意力比例降低二次复杂度，通过注意力残差复用锚点特征；在单张高端数据中心显卡上，四十步采样的四百八十像素视频用时十三点二秒，七百二十像素长视频的编译前向比全软最大值基线快三点二倍，结合完整优化栈后五十亿参数流水线在七百二十像素、五秒视频上用时十三点零六秒。

Mage-Flow: An Efficient Native-Resolution Foundation Model for Image Generation and Editing

CategoryAreaCompilers, Kernels, and Hardware / GPU / Accelerator KernelsTopicCUDA / kernel optimization
Xinjie Zhang, Peng Zhang, Shicheng Zheng, Jinghao Guo, Zhaoyang Jia, Yifei Shen et al.
medium · 2026-07-21

Why it matters This paper shows an end-to-end path for reducing high-resolution image-generation cost by co-designing a lightweight visual tokenizer, native-resolution packing, and stack-level CUDA kernel fusion. For researchers optimizing visual-generation systems, it reports about 2.5× higher training throughput and single-A100 latency of 0.59 seconds for 1024² generation and 1.02 seconds for editing, giving concrete system-level targets beyond model architecture alone.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 72)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Large visual generators are expensive to train, fine-tune, and deploy, particularly for high-resolution workloads.

02
Method

The stack combines one-step diffusion-style latent encoding and decoding, a native-resolution multimodal diffusion transformer, rectified flow matching, and CUDA kernel fusion.

03
Difference

Instead of relying mainly on scale, it co-designs the tokenizer, backbone, and system implementation and supplies base, aligned, and few-step inference variants.

04
Evidence

The abstract reports more than an order-of-magnitude lower tokenization cost, about 2.5× higher end-to-end training throughput, and 0.59-second generation plus 1.02-second editing on one NVIDIA A100.

Abstract

Large-scale visual generators are increasingly capable but costly to train, fine-tune, and deploy. We introduce Mage-Flow, a compact 4B-scale generative stack for efficient text-to-image generation and instruction-based image editing. The stack is built from two co-designed components: Mage-VAE, a lightweight high-fidelity latent tokenizer, and a Native-Resolution Multimodal Diffusion Transformer trained with rectified flow matching. Mage-VAE uses one-step diffusion-style encoding and decoding with anchor-latent regularization, preserving the reconstruction quality of strong public VAEs while reducing tokenization cost by more than an order of magnitude. Together with native-resolution packing and stack-level CUDA kernel fusion, the stack supports flexible-resolution training and improves end-to-end training throughput by about 2.5times. Built on this foundation, we develop a complete model family with Base, RL-aligned, and Turbo variants for both generation and editing. Diffusion-NFT improves prompt following, text rendering, aesthetic quality, and editing fidelity, while few-step distillation with adversarial perceptual guidance produces 4-step Turbo models for low-latency inference. Despite its compact scale, Mage-Flow and Mage-Flow-Edit achieves competitive performance across standard generation and editing benchmarks. More importantly, the Turbo variants make high-resolution generation and editing practical for interactive use: at 1024^2 resolution on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, Mage-Flow-Turbo generates an image in 0.59s, and Mage-Flow-Edit-Turbo edits an image in 1.02s, while maintaining a small memory footprint. These results show that careful tokenizer--backbone--system co-design can deliver strong high-resolution generation and editing within an efficient 4B model family.

Unified Static-Dynamic Pruning for Efficient LLM Inference

CategoryAreaCompilers, Kernels, and Hardware / GPU / Accelerator KernelsTopicCUDA / kernel optimization
Jinhyeok Kim, Yejoon Lee, Jaeyoung Do
cites 2 · high · 2026-07-24

Why it matters This work targets a real serving bottleneck in autoregressive decoding by placing permanent and input-adaptive sparsity under one GPU storage and kernel design, while also covering prefill. If the reported gains hold in independent deployments, it gives inference-engine developers a route to improve bandwidth use, compute intensity, and performance per watt without choosing between static-only and dynamic-only pruning.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Static pruning lacks input adaptivity, while dynamic pruning creates runtime irregularity for GPU LLM inference.

02
Method

The system combines a Tiled-Column-wise Bitmap Compressed format with a CUDA-core spMspV kernel for activation skipping and a Tensor-Core SpMM kernel for prefill.

03
Difference

Instead of treating the two sparsity sources separately, it co-designs the format and kernels to coordinate permanent weight sparsity with input-dependent activation sparsity.

04
Evidence

On inference-optimized GPUs, the paper reports 1.24x–1.37x average speedup and up to 2.51x speedup over sparse frameworks, with up to 25% higher sparsity at matched perplexity.

Abstract

The increasing deployment of large language models (LLMs) has magnified the computational and memory bottlenecks of autoregressive decoding, where low compute intensity and bandwidth-bound kernels dominate inference cost. Weight pruning offers a promising remedy, but existing methods remain confined to either static pruning (SP), which permanently removes redundant weights but lacks adaptivity, or dynamic pruning (DP), which adapts to input sparsity but introduces runtime irregularity. This paper presents SPDP, a unified sparse-inference framework that integrates unstructured SP with input-adaptive DP for efficient LLM inference on GPUs. SPDP co-designs a new Tiled-Column-wise Bitmap Compressed (Tiled-CBC) format and two complementary GPU kernels: (1) a CUDA-core spMspV kernel featuring Hybrid Activation-aware Dynamic Shared-Memory Bitmap Decoding (HAD-SMBD) for fine-grained, runtime activation skipping, and (2) a Tensor-Core SpMM kernel optimized for prefill computation. This joint format-kernel design harmonizes static and dynamic sparsity, maintaining bandwidth-efficient memory access and high compute intensity under both phases of LLM inference. Comprehensive evaluations on inference-optimized GPUs demonstrate that SPDP achieves 1.24x-1.37x average speedup (up to 2.51x) over state-of-the- art sparse frameworks such as SpInfer, while matching. perplexity with up to 25% higher sparsity. SPDP advances the inference efficiency-quality Pareto frontier, showing that unified static-dynamic pruning can deliver substantial throughput and performance-per-watt improvements in large-scale LLM serving

SANA-Video 2.0: Hybrid Linear Attention with Attention Residuals for Efficient Video Generation

CategoryAreaCompilers, Kernels, and Hardware / GPU / Accelerator KernelsTopicCUDA / kernel optimization
Junsong Chen, Jincheng Yu, Yitong Li, Shuchen Xue, Haozhe Liu, Jingyu Xin et al.
high · 2026-07-23

Why it matters This work connects long-sequence attention design with a deployable single-GPU path for video diffusion. It replaces most quadratic attention with linear mixing while retaining periodic full-rank anchors, then adds compilation, caching, and sparse-attention optimizations; the paper reports a 3.2x faster compiled forward pass than a matched full-softmax baseline at 720p/60s and a further 3.58x gain from the full stack. That makes it relevant to researchers building long-video generation services or constrained single-GPU deployments.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 34)
Method brief
01
Problem

Full-softmax attention has quadratic cost as video token sequences grow, while pure linear attention loses complete token interactions.

02
Method

The model uses gated linear attention for most blocks, inserts gated softmax anchors at a 3:1 ratio, and passes block summaries through Block Attention Residuals.

03
Difference

It trains the hybrid architecture from scratch instead of linearizing a pretrained full-softmax model, while reusing anchor representations across later layers.

04
Evidence

Proxy studies identify 25% softmax attention as the quality-efficiency trade-off, and the paper reports a VBench score of 84.30 with 13.2-second 480p sampling on one H100.

Abstract

We introduce SANA-Video 2.0, a hybrid video diffusion transformer instantiated at 5B and 14B scales under a unified architecture. Designed to generate high-quality video up to 720p on a single GPU, SANA-Video 2.0 matches full-softmax video DiTs in quality while retaining the favorable long-sequence scaling of linear attention. To avoid quadratic attention throughout, Hybrid Linear-Softmax Attention combines gated linear attention for O(N)-dominated mixing with periodic gated-softmax anchors at a 3:1 ratio, restoring the full-rank token interactions that pure linear attention lacks. To propagate these refreshed representations across depth, Block Attention Residuals (AttnRes) route completed block summaries into later linear layers, enabling anchor-feature reuse and boosting deep-layer effective rank by ~12%. Through from-scratch training, SANA-Video 2.0 learns the complete hybrid directly rather than linearizing pretrained models, with reduced-resolution proxy studies establishing 25% softmax as the optimal quality-efficiency trade-off. With 40-step sampling, SANA-Video 2.0 achieves a VBench score of 84.30 in 13.2s at 480p on a single H100, remaining competitive with far larger softmax video DiTs at a fraction of the latency. Its compiled DiT forward pass is 3.2x faster than a matched full-softmax baseline at 720p/60s, a gap that expands with video duration. Furthermore, full-stack Sol-Engine optimization (kernel fusion, caching, and sparse attention) accelerates this hardware-friendly backbone by a further 3.58x, bringing the 5B pipeline to 13.06s at 720p/5s and making it 120x faster than Wan 2.2-A14B on one H100. Overall, our hybrid design recovers softmax-level expressiveness at substantially reduced cost, unlocking scalable long, high resolution video generation.

SLAI T-Rex: Full-Parameter Post-training of the DeepSeek-V4 Family on Ascend SuperPOD

CategoryAreaTraining Systems / Parallel and Distributed TrainingTopiclarge-scale pretraining systems
Dongfang Li, Xiaodong Luo, Ruoyu Sun, Xuhui Chen, Linyuan Qiu, Jian Meng et al.
high · 2026-07-22

Why it matters This report gives infrastructure teams a concrete path for full-parameter post-training of trillion-parameter MoE models on Ascend SuperPOD rather than GPU clusters. Its cross-layer work on parallelism, communication orchestration, and kernels reaches 34.22% MFU, a claimed 2.93x gain over the open-source baseline, making it especially relevant to teams scaling post-training on NPU systems.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 60)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Full-parameter post-training for trillion-parameter MoE models suffers from severe memory pressure, non-overlapped communication, and inefficient kernel execution.

02
Method

The system jointly optimizes model-level parallelism, computation-communication orchestration, and low-level kernels, then adds CPT and SFT data pipelines for operations-research tasks.

03
Difference

Unlike the GPU-oriented recipes common in large-scale LLM training, the work optimizes the complete post-training stack for an Ascend SuperPOD.

04
Evidence

The report claims 34.22% MFU, a 2.93x improvement over the open-source baseline, and a specialized model with 71.81% zero-shot Pass@1.

Abstract

Full-parameter post-training of trillion-parameter-scale MoE models introduces substantial system-level challenges for large-scale distributed training, including severe memory pressure, non-overlapped communication overhead, and inefficient kernel execution. While most large-scale LLM training systems are built around GPU-based clusters, this report presents an end-to-end optimization practice on the Ascend NPU SuperPOD. Using the DeepSeek-V4 model family as the target workload, we develop a hierarchical optimization framework spanning model-level parallelism, computation-communication orchestration, and low-level kernel execution. The resulting system achieves 34.22% Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) with a 2.93x improvement over the open-source baseline recipe while maintaining training stability. Building on this optimized infrastructure, we further establish a CPT and SFT workflow for complex Operations Research (OR) tasks. We refer to the integrated framework as SLAI T-Rex. Using DeepSeek-V4-Flash, we develop OR-oriented CPT and SFT data pipelines that combine collected domain resources with solver-verified synthetic optimization documents. The resulting dataset contains 10K high-quality SFT samples spanning four task categories and three problem representations. The specialized model achieves the highest average zero-shot Pass@1 score among the evaluated models, reaching 71.81% and outperforming GPT-5.4-Mini and the base DeepSeek-V4-Flash model by 3.98 and 11.27 percentage points, respectively. Overall, this work demonstrates a full-stack pathway from efficient trillion-parameter model post-training on Ascend infra to domain-specialized Flash models for solver-grounded mathematical modeling, advancing frontier-model systems for complex reasoning.

Stale but Stable: Staleness-Adaptive Trust Regions for Stabilizing Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning

CategoryAreaTraining Systems / Parallel and Distributed TrainingTopiclarge-scale pretraining systems
Junyao Yang, Yucheng Shi, Zongxia Li, Zhongzhi Li, Ruhan Wang, Xiangxin Zhou et al.
high · 2026-07-21

Why it matters This paper targets a real systems failure mode in asynchronous LLM reinforcement learning: policy lag from decoupled rollout and optimization. Its staleness-aware clipping tightens updates only for high-mismatch samples, offering a way to retain asynchronous throughput while reducing instability caused by stale rollouts, engine delays, and MoE routing inconsistency.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 35)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Policy lag, inference-engine delay, and MoE routing inconsistency make stale asynchronous rollouts produce weakly controlled updates.

02
Method

SAT uses a detached sampled log-ratio as a staleness proxy, scales kernels for high-mismatch tails within each batch, and contracts the sign-selected endpoint of the nominal PPO interval.

03
Difference

Unlike uniform clipping, it preserves baseline behavior for ordinary tokens while adding conservative constraints to newly exposed outward update bands.

04
Evidence

The paper proves local interval containment and pointwise pessimism relative to PPO, then evaluates the method with Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base, SGLang, and Megatron under multiple lag settings.

Abstract

Asynchronous reinforcement learning improves throughput by decoupling rollout generation from optimization, but staleness is an inevitable byproduct compounded by policy lag, engine delays, and mixture-of-experts routing. From a trust-region perspective, this mismatch is critical: training-inference divergence governs approximation error in finite-horizon bounds, whereas PPO clipping only gates sampled outward updates, acting as a sampled surrogate rather than a full-policy constraint. As a result, high-staleness updates remain weakly controlled in the asynchronous regime where stale rollouts matter most. We introduce the Staleness-Adaptive Trust Region (SAT), which uses the detached sampled log-ratio as a practical staleness proxy, identifies high-mismatch tails within each batch via staleness-based kernel scaling, and contracts only the sign-selected endpoint of the nominal PPO interval. This preserves baseline behavior on ordinary tokens while enforcing more conservative updates on newly intercepted outward bands. We prove local interval containment and pointwise pessimism relative to PPO, showing how the adaptive rule reshapes update geometry under heterogeneous staleness. We evaluate SAT in a decoupled asynchronous RL setup built on Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base, using SGLang as the inference engine and Megatron for training. In this setting, SAT-GSPO w/ R3 achieves the best observed AIME24 avg@8, reaching 35.83 at lag 1 and 34.79 at lag 8, while SAT-GSPO reaches 34.17 at lag 1. Adaptive clipping and routing replay act as complementary stabilizers targeting mismatch tails and routing inconsistency, respectively. Overall, aligning clip intervals with staleness heterogeneity effectively stabilizes asynchronous RL.

Sparse by Command: Task-Conditional Compute Skipping for Multi-Task Inference Accelerators

CategoryAreaCompilers, Kernels, and Hardware / GPU / Accelerator KernelsTopicaccelerator / edge inference
Afzal Ahmad, Gaoyu Mao, Shoubo Hu, Hui-Ling Zhen, Mingxuan Yuan, Xinyu Chen et al.
high · 2026-07-24

Why it matters The work turns a task command into hardware-level execution skipping for shared multi-task backbones, targeting edge inference deployments where latency and energy matter. Because masks match the accelerator's native tile granularity, it avoids model-architecture and pipeline changes while reporting 66–76% fewer FLOPs and 51–59% lower on-device latency on a closed-loop driving task.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

A shared multi-task backbone executes task-irrelevant operations even when the active task is known before inference.

02
Method

A jointly trained lightweight gate predicts command-conditioned binary masks for fixed output-channel tiles, while masked-tile fields in the instruction set control hardware skipping.

03
Difference

The design co-optimizes training, instruction encoding, and a tiled INT8 accelerator so sparse execution follows the hardware's native scheduling unit without software intervention.

04
Evidence

An AMD/Xilinx Alveo U50 prototype evaluated in CARLA reports 66–76% FLOP reduction, 2.1–2.4× speedup, and energy reduction from 263 to 108–128 mJ per inference.

Abstract

Multi-task inference models share a single backbone across diverse tasks, yet execute identical computation regardless of which task is active - wasting energy and cycles on task-irrelevant operations. We observe that the task command, typically available before inference begins, provides a free signal that can be exploited to skip unnecessary computation at the hardware level. We present a HW/SW co-designed approach in which a lightweight gating network, trained jointly with the backbone, predicts per-tile binary execution masks conditioned on the task input. Each tile corresponds to a fixed group of output channels (the native scheduling granularity of the accelerator), enabling masked tiles to be skipped with zero overhead. This yields a task-dependent reduction in compute, where each command activates only the subset of the network it requires, without changes to the model architecture or inference pipeline. We co-design the full system stack: a command-conditioned training procedure that learns hardware-aligned tile masks under a sparsity objective; an instruction set architecture whose instructions carry per-tile bitmask fields, allowing the hardware to skip masked tiles without software intervention; and a tiled inference accelerator with configurable parallelism, double-buffered memory, and INT8 datapath that natively supports sparse tile execution. We prototype on an AMD/Xilinx Alveo U50 FPGA and evaluate on a closed-loop visuomotor driving task in CARLA autonomous driving simulator. Task-conditional sparsity reduces FLOPs by 66-76% while maintaining driving quality. On-device latency decreases by 51-59%, from 9.12 ms to 3.74-4.44 ms (2.1-2.4x speedup), with energy per inference dropping from 263 to 108-128mJ.

HEMERA: A Heterogeneous Memory-Centric Accelerator with Recursive Dataflow for Edge-Constrained State-Space-Duality Models Inference

CategoryAreaCompilers, Kernels, and Hardware / GPU / Accelerator KernelsTopicaccelerator / edge inference
Hao Ding, Ling Liang, Ruitong Qiao, Dongxue Zhao, Xiantong Qiu, Jinshan Li et al.
high · 2026-07-24

Why it matters This targets a real inference bottleneck in long-context state-space models: quadratic intermediates, irregular movement, and prefix-dependent execution. Its streaming-recursive mapping removes the need to materialize those intermediates, while the reported 1.4x–3.6x latency speedup and 12.2x–27.0x energy-efficiency gain over the optimized fused Mamba-2 kernel make it relevant to bandwidth- and power-constrained edge deployments.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Matrix-form SSD execution creates quadratic intermediate storage and makes dependency-bound state propagation inefficient on conventional hardware.

02
Method

The design reformulates SSD as an algebraically equivalent streaming-recursive dataflow and splits execution between in-memory computing units and a dedicated streaming engine.

03
Difference

Instead of retaining matrix-oriented SSD execution, it maps dense linear work and recursive state updates to different hardware paths.

04
Evidence

Across Mamba-2 models from 130M to 2.8B parameters, the paper reports 1.4x–3.6x latency speedups and 12.2x–27.0x energy-efficiency improvements over the official optimized fused kernel on NVIDIA A100.

Abstract

Structured State Space Models (SSMs), such as Mamba, enable efficient long-sequence modeling with linear time complexity. Recent implementations realize this capability through Structured State Space Duality (SSD), which transforms recursive state evolution into matrix-form computations. However, SSD introduces substantial system-level overheads, including quadratic intermediate materialization, irregular data movement, and prefix-dependent execution, leading to excessive memory traffic and bandwidth demand on conventional architectures. Although prior accelerators mitigate these overheads through optimized dataflows or compute-in-memory techniques, they largely retain matrix-oriented SSD execution and cannot simultaneously avoid quadratic intermediate storage and efficiently map dependency-bound state propagation. This paper presents HEMERA, a heterogeneous memory-centric accelerator for efficient Mamba-2 inference. Rather than directly executing the matrix-form SSD computation, HEMERA reformulates it into an algebraically equivalent streaming-recursive dataflow that avoids quadratic intermediate storage while preserving the original computation. The resulting heterogeneous execution paradigm maps dense linear operations onto in-memory computing units and recursive state updates onto a dedicated streaming engine. Across Mamba-2 models ranging from 130M to 2.8B, HEMERA achieves average latency speedups of 1.4x-3.6x and energy-efficiency improvements of 12.2x-27.0x over the official optimized fused Mamba-2 kernel on NVIDIA A100. It further reduces the average SSD-related execution-time ratio across model scales to 14.12% during long-sequence inference, demonstrating its potential for efficient deployment under edge constraints.

FVAttn: Adaptive Sparse Attention with Runtime Load Balancing for Video Generation

CategoryAreaCompilers, Kernels, and Hardware / Compilers and RuntimeTopiccompiler / runtime
Hao Liu, Chenghuan Huang, Ye Huang, Zhiying Wen, Hao Liu, Mohan Zhang et al.
high · 2026-07-17

Why it matters It addresses the rank stragglers that can erase the benefit of adaptive sparse attention under multi-GPU sequence parallelism. Without retraining, it moves overloaded heads and uses otherwise idle ranks, making sparse attention more practical for high-resolution video diffusion inference.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 8)
Method brief
01
Problem

Top-p routing creates heterogeneous per-head workloads across ranks in multi-GPU sequence-parallel attention.

02
Method

The system migrates a small number of heavy heads and fills non-critical-rank slack with additional high-value blocks while overlapping this work with computation.

03
Difference

Instead of accepting the materialized sparse mask, it repairs runtime work placement through communication and slack-aware augmentation without retraining.

04
Evidence

On step-distilled Wan2.2 I2V, it reduces average load imbalance from 1.34 to 1.08, gives 4.41× attention speedup, and gives 2.02–2.11× DiT inference speedup with competitive video quality.

Abstract

Video Diffusion Transformers process long spatio-temporal sequences, making self-attention the main bottleneck in high-resolution video generation. Training-free sparse attention reduces this cost, but adaptive Top-p routing creates uneven per-head workloads under multi-GPU sequence parallelism. The resulting workload heterogeneity turns sparse attention into a rank-level straggler problem. We present , a training-free sparse-attention system that improves the distributed execution efficiency of adaptive sparse attention under multi-GPU sequence parallelism. uses Top-p routing, a Top-k safety floor, and video-aware block organization as the sparse-routing frontend, then repairs the materialized mask at runtime. Runtime Load Balancing migrates a small number of heavy heads via P2P communication to shorten the current critical path. Slack-Aware Sparse Augmentation fills residual non-critical-rank slack with additional high-value blocks, while overlap hides scheduling and migration overhead behind existing computation. On step-distilled Wan2.2 I2V, reduces average load imbalance from 1.34 to 1.08 and delivers a 4.41times attention speedup over FlashAttention, while achieving a 2.02--2.11times DiT inference speedup with competitive video quality.

llm-agents.body:
01 / 论文

📄 论文

主题reasoning / planning

01
论文 / 高优先级

Molt: A Scalable PyTorch-Native Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

分类主题reasoning / planning
Jian Hu, Huiying Li, Hao Zhang, Binfeng Xu, Yifan Zhang, Shaokun Zhang et al.
high · 2026-07-22

为什么值得看 它把智能体强化学习的训练器、分布式执行和采样流程压缩成研究者可整体理解的原生深度学习框架，使多模态与混合专家策略的异步算法迭代不必反复修改多层基础设施，同时在匹配协议下达到与主流大型训练栈统计相当的效果。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 15）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有智能体强化学习框架让每次修改估计器、训练阶段或采样方案都要贯穿训练器、分布式后端和回滚代码。

02
方法

该框架用紧凑的原生深度学习代码和一个异步循环训练多模态及混合专家策略，并让智能体作为普通程序运行。

03
差异

它强调端到端可追踪和可修改，同时在令牌来源、策略版本与模型语义上保持一致，避免使用智能体未生成的令牌训练。

04
证据

在匹配的完全异步协议下，论文称其结果与基于主流大型训练栈的系统统计相当，并提供开源代码、配方和容器。

摘要

智能体强化学习研究经常修改算法、估计器、训练阶段和回滚方案，而现有框架会把这些变化扩散到训练器、分布式后端和采样代码中。该框架以紧凑的原生深度学习代码实现一个异步训练循环，支持多模态和混合专家策略，并保证只使用智能体实际生成的令牌进行训练；在匹配的完全异步协议下，其性能与基于主流大型训练栈的系统统计相当。

潜力 75新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
11 位作者0 所机构55 条合作线
02
论文 / 高优先级

The Regression Tax: Decomposing Why Skills Help and Hurt LLM Agents

分类主题reasoning / planning
Darshan Tank, Baran Nama
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 它提醒代理研究者不要只看技能带来的平均成功率，因为技能可能通过上下文渗透、取代输入理解或压制结果检查而制造回归；对办公自动化代理而言，优先改进接地与验证可能比继续增加流程指导更能提升可靠性。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

论文研究如何区分程序技能带来的任务收益、技能引发的回归，以及无论是否使用技能都失败的残余错误。

02
方法

作者在两个办公自动化基准、三套模型运行框架和近六千次运行中，对比带技能与不带技能的代理表现并分析执行轨迹。

03
差异

分析把技能影响拆成技能未被调用却改变行为的上下文渗透、程序取代输入理解的接地置换，以及程序压制输出检查的验证置换。

04
证据

结果显示高表现技能主要是减少回归而非增加收益，且许多回归和持续失败可通过改进接地与验证恢复。

摘要

论文指出，向大语言模型代理加入程序技能时，只看任务成功率的平均变化会掩盖技能造成的失败。基于两个办公自动化基准、三套模型运行框架和近六千次运行，作者将回归归因于上下文渗透、接地置换和验证置换，并发现代理可靠性更多取决于接地与验证，而不是程序技能本身的选择。

潜力 29新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
2 位作者0 所机构1 条合作线
03
论文 / 高优先级

Agentic Root Cause Analysis through Evidence-Grounded Reasoning

分类主题reasoning / planning
Amaury Wei, Olga Fink
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 它展示了代理可以把数字孪生、统计工具和假设比较结合起来，在没有故障标注的工业场景中完成可追溯的根因诊断，为研究面向真实系统的证据驱动推理与工具调用提供了直接案例。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

工业异常根因诊断依赖人工提出假设和收集证据，现有数据驱动方法又常缺乏可解释性并需要稀缺故障标注。

02
方法

系统用描述正常动力学的数据驱动数字孪生配合工具增强的大语言模型，在推理时迭代收集统计证据、评估竞争假设并定位物理故障。

03
差异

它不学习特定故障到诊断结果的映射，而是通过零样本、假设驱动的证据推理完成诊断。

04
证据

在真实多相流设施和大型化工厂上，系统据称达到与完全监督基线有竞争力的诊断表现，并生成连接症状与物理原因的推理轨迹。

摘要

论文提出一种零样本代理框架，用数据驱动数字孪生和工具增强的大语言模型进行证据驱动的工业根因分析；代理会迭代收集统计证据、比较假设，并找出最能解释观测行为的物理故障。在真实多相流设施和大型化工厂上的评估显示，该方法无需特定故障训练即可取得与完全监督基线有竞争力的诊断表现，同时提供明确连接症状和根因的推理轨迹。

潜力 36新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
2 位作者1 所机构1 条合作线

主题tool use / function calling

04
论文 / 高优先级

Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills

分类主题tool use / function calling
Siyuan Huang, Pengyu Cheng, Haotian Liu, Tao Chen, Yihao Liu, Jingwei Ni et al.
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 它用可验证的技能执行反馈配合动态技能路由，把工具使用与推理代理中的任务覆盖面和奖励可靠性结合起来，并声称能提升已有模型上限、纠正初始失配模型，适合关注自我进化训练的研究者。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 23）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有自我进化方法难以同时获得开放任务多样性和可靠的结果验证。

02
方法

技能自博弈由任务提议者、解题者和动态技能控制器组成强化学习循环，持续生成任务、探索解法并更新技能库。

03
差异

它以每个场景内可深度验证的技能为基本单元，再通过动态路由扩展任务空间，而不是只依赖固定环境或无约束自生成。

04
证据

在工具使用和推理基准上的实验声称持续提高已有模型表现，并让初始失配模型出现明显性能转变。

摘要

论文指出，自我进化训练面临任务多样性与验证可靠性之间的矛盾：环境绑定方法反馈准确但领域狭窄，开放式自生成方法覆盖面广却容易产生误导性奖励。为此，技能自博弈让任务提议者、解题者和动态技能控制器围绕技能库持续协同进化，以技能执行反馈连接结构化验证与开放探索；在工具使用和推理基准上，作者声称该方法能提升已有模型能力上限，并改善初始失配模型的表现。

潜力 56新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
12 位作者1 所机构11 条合作线
05
论文 / 高优先级

Multi-Head Latent Control: A Unified Interface for LLM Agent Decision Making

分类主题tool use / function calling
Amirhosein Ghasemabadi, Ruichen Chen, Bahador Rashidi, Di Niu
high · 2026-07-15

为什么值得看 它让冻结的大语言模型直接从生成过程的隐藏状态判断是否继续推理、转交更强模型、澄清、调用工具或 abstain，从而减少外部编排和模型改动，在安卓世界任务中最多减少百分之九十点七的大模型调用，并显著降低漏掉必需工具调用的情况。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 4）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有代理控制多依赖提示词路由、外部编排或任务专用微调，维护成本高且难随主干模型演进。

02
方法

方法在冻结的大语言模型或视觉语言模型上读取隐藏状态轨迹，并训练能力头和决策头输出转交及澄清、工具调用、拒答、直接回答信号。

03
差异

它只利用同一冻结主干模型的潜在生成轨迹进行事后适配，不修改主模型参数。

04
证据

在语言和视觉语言设置中，方法声称改善多模型系统的质量成本权衡，并提升工具调用决策得分、减少漏调用。

摘要

论文研究如何从模型的潜在生成过程推断代理在推理时应继续执行、转交更强模型、请求补充信息、调用工具或拒答。作者提出一个轻量层，从冻结的大语言模型或视觉语言模型的隐藏状态轨迹中预测能力和具体决策；在路由执行中，方法最多减少百分之九十点七的大模型使用量，同时保持大部分大模型性能，并使工具调用决策相对得分最高提升百分之一百五十八、漏掉必需工具调用的情况减少百分之六十五点五。

4 位作者1 所机构6 条合作线

主题memory / RAG agents

06
论文 / 高优先级

Agentic Context Management: Solving Agent Memory and Cost by Treating Them as Lifecycle and Architecture Problems

分类主题memory / RAG agents

论文指出，自我进化训练面临任务多样性与验证可靠性之间的矛盾：环境绑定方法反馈准确但领域狭窄，开放式自生成方法覆盖面广却容易产生误导性奖励。为此，技能自博弈让任务提议者、解题者和动态技能控制器围绕技能库持续协同进化，以技能执行反馈连接结构化验证与开放探索；在工具使用和推理基准上，作者声称该方法能提升已有模型能力上限，并改善初始失配模型的表现。

分类主题tool use / function calling
Amirhosein Ghasemabadi, Ruichen Chen, Bahador Rashidi, Di Niu
high · 2026-07-15

为什么值得看 它让冻结的大语言模型直接从生成过程的隐藏状态判断是否继续推理、转交更强模型、澄清、调用工具或 abstain，从而减少外部编排和模型改动，在安卓世界任务中最多减少百分之九十点七的大模型调用，并显著降低漏掉必需工具调用的情况。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 4）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有代理控制多依赖提示词路由、外部编排或任务专用微调，维护成本高且难随主干模型演进。

02
方法

方法在冻结的大语言模型或视觉语言模型上读取隐藏状态轨迹，并训练能力头和决策头输出转交及澄清、工具调用、拒答、直接回答信号。

03
差异

它只利用同一冻结主干模型的潜在生成轨迹进行事后适配，不修改主模型参数。

04
证据

在语言和视觉语言设置中，方法声称改善多模型系统的质量成本权衡，并提升工具调用决策得分、减少漏调用。

摘要

论文研究如何从模型的潜在生成过程推断代理在推理时应继续执行、转交更强模型、请求补充信息、调用工具或拒答。作者提出一个轻量层，从冻结的大语言模型或视觉语言模型的隐藏状态轨迹中预测能力和具体决策；在路由执行中，方法最多减少百分之九十点七的大模型使用量，同时保持大部分大模型性能，并使工具调用决策相对得分最高提升百分之一百五十八、漏掉必需工具调用的情况减少百分之六十五点五。

Agentic Context Management: Solving Agent Memory and Cost by Treating Them as Lifecycle and Architecture Problems

分类主题memory / RAG agents

high · 2026-07-23

为什么值得看 它把智能体记忆从单纯的存储检索改成覆盖记忆、分层存储、范围管理、预测、压缩与整合的生命周期管理，并声称在保持信息保真度的同时把随对话增长的上下文成本从二次增长降为线性增长，直接针对生产智能体的遗忘和费用问题。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 15）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

论文研究对话历史、提示词、工具定义和工具输出持续膨胀导致的上下文遗忘与令牌成本上升。

02
方法

论文将上下文管理分为架构设计、信息摄取、范围划分、需求预测以及压缩与整合五个基本操作，并给出多租户服务实现。

03
差异

该方法把记忆视为涵盖选择、结构化、存储、合并、遗忘、相关性判断和预算压缩的生命周期，而不只是存储与检索。

04
证据

所述实现按文中配置在长程记忆评测上达到百分之九十二、在社交常识长程记忆评测上达到百分之九十三点二，并讨论延迟、令牌效率和上下文腐化抗性。

摘要

论文指出，生产智能体的主要失败原因常是无法管理不断累积的推理上下文，而非推理能力不足；单纯增加存储和检索并不能解决记忆、成本与上下文预算问题。论文提出“智能体上下文管理”这一生命周期视角，将管理拆为架构设计、摄取、范围划分、预测以及压缩与整合五个基本操作，并声称其参考实现在线性成本增长下保持信息保真度，在长程记忆评测和社交常识长程记忆评测上分别达到百分之九十二和百分之九十三点二。

方法解读
01
问题

现有系统通常分别优化构想质量或多样性，因而容易产生相近构想或大量琐碎、不可靠的构想。

02
方法

系统通过多个智能体维护构想谱系，用多目标反馈进行修复与细化，并以顺序记忆比较已完成构想、历史祖先和被拒方案。

03
差异

研究将构想生成明确建模为质量与多样性同时满足的搜索，并提出衡量两者结合效果的产出指标。

04
证据

在八个领域的三十二个主题上，系统的产出指标达到最佳基线的三点八九倍，并在八倍多的主题上取得非零产出。

摘要

论文指出，现有大语言模型科研发现系统通常独立优化构想质量或多样性，容易生成彼此接近或质量不足的构想，因此将科研构想生成定义为同时追求两者的质量—多样性搜索，并提出由多个智能体沿构想谱系演化的系统。该系统用多目标反馈修复和细化构想，以轻量级顺序记忆和对历史构想的显式比较维持多样性；作者还提出联合指标并在八个计算机科学领域的三十二个主题上评估，报告其指标达到最佳基线的三点八九倍，并认为修复与细化有助于提升逻辑严谨性和清晰度而保留非显然性。

Ritik Raj, Souvik Kundu, Sarbartha Banerjee, Dheemanth Joshi, Ishita Vohra, Tushar Krishna
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 它把模型路由从逐次调用的局部决策改为任务级的一次选择，用终局奖励同时学习准确率与延迟，在两个基准上相对现有模型组合或单模型基线取得了明确收益，适合需要控制长流程代理成本与质量的部署者。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

长时程代理工作流的质量由延迟到达的任务结果决定，使逐次调用路由难以把反馈归因到正确的决策。

02
方法

方法在任务接入时用上下文多臂老虎机选择一个模型，随后将该任务的所有大语言模型调用固定到该后端，并用终局奖励更新策略。

03
差异

它以任务而非单次调用作为监督单位，同时优化准确率和延迟，并避免显式估计任务复杂度。

04
证据

在三个代理基准上，方法均取得非支配的准确率—延迟前沿点；在客户服务基准上比延迟匹配的模型插值高七至八个准确率点，在终端操作基准上比最强单模型高七点一分且延迟低百分之三十六。

摘要

现有模型路由器主要为每次大语言模型调用独立决策，但代理应用运行的是由延迟任务结果评估的长时程工作流，导致调用级反馈归因不当。该方法在任务接入时用上下文多臂老虎机为整个任务选择并固定一个后端，再利用任务终局奖励联合学习准确率与延迟；在三个代理基准上改善了准确率—延迟权衡，并在客户服务基准和终端操作基准上分别取得七至八个及七点一分的准确率优势，同时后者降低百分之三十六延迟。

方法解读
01
问题

行为克隆微调会逐步覆盖支撑视觉和语义泛化的预训练表征，而网页图文联合训练仍无法保证语言与动作对齐。

02
方法

方法加入视觉语言锚定和语言动作对齐两个目标，前者从冻结的视觉语言模型逐层蒸馏表征，后者把动作目标转成离散运动方向并与语言预测联合训练。

03
差异

它让语言损失和动作损失作用于同一个机器人观测，同时保留冻结模型的层级表征，而不是仅在分离的网页图文与机器人数据上共同训练。

04
证据

在实体七自由度机械臂和两种视觉语言动作架构上，成功率分别由百分之二十八升至百分之五十四、由百分之三十七升至百分之六十，并在多个模拟基准的分布外扰动、感知鲁棒性和长时控制上持续提升。

摘要

该工作指出，直接用行为克隆微调预训练视觉语言模型会损害视觉和语义泛化能力，而网页图文联合训练也会造成语言与动作错配。其方法通过视觉语言表征锚定保持冻结模型的逐层表征，并把动作目标转为离散运动方向，与语言预测在同一机器人观测上联合训练；在实体机械臂和多个模拟基准上均报告了成功率、分布外鲁棒性及长时控制的提升。

方法解读
01
问题

现有通用策略试图用大规模预训练同时承担感知、规划、成功检测、恢复和低层控制，但这些能力难以协同。

方法

系统将语言条件策略或参数化技能与物理代理编排器结合，由编排器拆分目标、下达动作、检查低层观测并触发恢复。

03
差异

它不通过额外数据收集或后训练让策略学会推理，而是在策略外增加负责闭环决策的高层代理管理器。

论文指出，通用机器人所需的感知、世界知识、规划、成功检测、恢复和低层控制可以拆分为语言条件策略或控制代理，以及负责高层管理的编排器。作者构建了闭环物理代理编排器皮吉，使冻结的视觉语言动作策略和参数化技能能够在无需额外数据或后训练的情况下完成复杂真实世界任务，并在模拟与真实操作评测中显著提升性能。

ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU

分类主题video / generative world models
Fan Jiang, Zhaoxu Sun, Mengchao Wang, Ziyu Zhu, Chiyu Wang, Yunpeng Zhang et al.
high · 2026-07-21

为什么值得看 它把可控视频世界模型从短片生成推进到单张桌面级显卡上的实时长时闭环交互，并用长时教师蒸馏缓解自回归漂移，为需要低延迟探索和规划的研究者提供了可运行的世界模型系统。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 298）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

系统需要根据键盘动作实时生成可持续交互的长时视频世界，同时保持控制响应、场景演化和角色身份一致性。

02
方法

方法整合多来源数据采集、质量筛选、双向动作条件教师到因果学生的教师强制与常微分方程蒸馏，并加入长时蒸馏、角色记忆和低比特流式推理。

03
差异

相较于只对短期自回归预测训练学生模型，该方法用扩展时域教师约束学生自回滚，并以统一键盘动作接口覆盖场景漫游和第三人称角色交互。

04
证据

在单张英伟达锐龙五零九零桌面显卡上，优化配置可生成七百二十像素视频、最高每秒十六帧，动作到首帧延迟为一点二秒、峰值显存约十九吉比字节，并在交互基准和长时回滚中报告了有竞争力的可控性与连贯性。

摘要

该工作介绍了一个动作条件视频世界模型，通过覆盖大型游戏、仿真引擎和互联网视频的数据基础设施学习可控世界动力学，并结合智能体驱动的数据采集、质量检查、视觉语言模型评估以及动作和文本标注。模型将双向教师蒸馏为因果学生，利用长时教师对齐学生自回滚以减轻分布偏移和漂移，同时通过角色记忆维持身份一致性；配合轻量解码器、高效注意力、显存感知调度和低比特推理，系统可在单张桌面级显卡上实时生成七百二十像素交互视频。

AlayaWorld: Interactive Long-Horizon World Modeling -- Full Technical Report

分类主题video / generative world models
AlayaWorld Team, Kaipeng Zhang, Chuanhao Li, Yifan Zhan, Yongtao Ge, Yuanyang Yin et al.
high · 2026-07-20

为什么值得看 它把交互控制、持久空间记忆、长时生成稳定性和低延迟推理放进同一套视频世界模型中，并将每个片段的采样从约三十步压到四步，为需要实时探索和长期一致性的研究者提供了可直接扩展的技术基础。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 57）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

交互式视频世界模型需要在用户控制下持续生成画面，同时维持空间与时间一致性并快速响应。

02
方法

该模型基于一百五十亿参数的视频扩散变换器，自回归生成短潜变量片段，并结合持久锚点帧、压缩历史、几何对齐空间记忆和近期帧条件。

03
差异

它用自身 rollout 收集的受扰历史与预测残差训练长期稳定性，并以分布匹配蒸馏、自强制增强和一致性蒸馏将每片段采样步数降至四步。

04
证据

系统可生成每秒二十四帧、五百四十或七百二十像素的视频，并声称在长时生成基准上取得最佳表现。

摘要

AlayaWorld 是一个交互式长时视频世界模型，能够根据用户输入、相机轨迹和可切换文本提示，自回归生成持续演化的虚拟环境，输出每秒二十四帧、五百四十或七百二十像素的视频。它通过有限视觉上下文中的持久锚点帧、压缩时间历史、几何对齐空间记忆和近期帧条件维持长期一致性，并利用受扰历史、自身 rollout 残差训练以及离散自回归蒸馏，将每个片段的推理采样从约三十步减少到四步；作者声称其在长时生成评测中表现最佳。

Generative World Renderer at the Speed of Play

分类主题video / generative world models
Guixu Lin, Zheng-Hui Huang, Siqi Yang, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Kaipeng Zhang, Zhixiang Wang
high · 2026-07-21

为什么值得看 它把物理引擎的结构化状态转成每秒三十帧的可交互画面，同时不改动底层世界动力学，为需要真实物理约束和用户可控生成的世界模型提供了比文本或控制提示驱动生成更直接的渲染路径。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 78）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

原始生成式世界渲染器每秒只能生成零点五六帧，难以支持实时部署。

02
方法

方法将渲染器改造成少步自回归流式模型，并使用轻量级蒸馏编解码器完成潜变量编码和帧重建。

03
差异

它保留教师模型的图形缓冲区与文本提示接口，并支持对无界长度输入流持续渲染。

04
证据

报告称速度提升至每秒三十一点五四帧，并与物理引擎结合构建了每秒三十帧的可游玩生成世界。

摘要

AlayaRenderer接收物理引擎导出的结构化世界状态并生成彩色画面，在不改变底层世界动力学的情况下保持场景结构；其加速版本将原始速度从每秒零点五六帧提升到每秒三十一点五四帧。该版本通过少步自回归流式建模和轻量级蒸馏编解码器降低推理成本，同时保留图形缓冲区与文本提示接口，并在多项画面、时序和运行效率指标上评估，最终与物理引擎结合实现了每秒三十帧的可游玩生成世界。

潜力 50新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号

Open-AoE: An Open Egocentric Manipulation Dataset and Toolchain for Embodied Learning

分类主题video / generative world models
Zishuo Li, Bowen Yang, Changtao Miao, Kai Zhu, Hao Chen, Qingze Guan et al.
high · 2026-07-15

为什么值得看 它把约两千小时、带手部姿态和相机轨迹的第一视角操作视频整理成可直接训练世界模型的结构化数据与工具链，降低了从人类示范学习连续操作动力学的采集和复用门槛。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 68）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有第一视角操作资源通常难以同时提供低成本持续采集、操作级标注和可复用的机器人学习工具。

02
方法

该工作汇集五百多名贡献者和四百多部手机拍摄的视频，并通过动作分段、语义标注、手部重建和相机轨迹重建生成结构化样本。

03
差异

它将从手机采集到模型训练的完整流程，与可视化、跨 embodiment 重定向、模型格式转换和训练配方整合在一个开放工具链中。

04
证据

首个版本包含约两千小时自然环境操作视频、文本标注、基于手部模型的手姿态、相机轨迹和时间定位的原子动作，并支持视觉语言动作策略、世界模型等下游训练。

摘要

该工作发布了一个开放的第一视角人类操作视频数据集和工具链，首个版本包含由五百多名贡献者使用四百多部手机在自然环境中采集的约两千小时视频，并提供文本标注、基于手部模型的手部姿态、相机轨迹和时间定位的原子动作。其处理流程把原始录像转换为结构化样本，同时提供可视化、跨 embodiment 重定向、模型专用数据转换和世界模型等下游训练配方，以支持具身模型训练、人类到机器人的迁移和世界建模。

Streaming Multi-Agent Autoregressive Diffusion Model with World State Registers

分类主题video / generative world models
Sicheng Mo, Yuheng Li, Ziyang Leng, Krishna Kumar Singh, Bolei Zhou
high · 2026-07-23

为什么值得看 它用可持续更新的跨智能体世界状态寄存器替代单纯堆叠观测历史，为多智能体、多视角视频生成提供共享且持久的状态记忆，并在双智能体《我的世界》实验中提升逻辑一致性与生成质量。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 12）
方法解读
01
问题

现有自回归视频扩散模型依赖观测历史作为条件，难以在多智能体和多视角 rollout 中维护共享状态。

02
方法

模型在每个生成片段后动态更新寄存器，并用个体状态、全局视角、鸟瞰图和场景文本监督这些可学习标记。

03
差异

混合变换器结构为世界状态建模和视觉帧建模使用分离的参数。

04
证据

在双智能体《我的世界》视频生成实验中，显式世界状态建模被报告为改善了逻辑一致性和生成质量。

摘要

世界编织器是一种流式多智能体视频扩散模型，通过跨智能体世界状态寄存器保存共享世界信息、跟踪个体状态，并在每个生成片段后动态更新。模型还以个体状态、包含鸟瞰图的全局状态视图和场景文本作为监督，并在双智能体《我的世界》视频生成实验中显示出更好的逻辑一致性和生成质量。

潜力 36新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
5 位作者1 所机构10 条合作线
06
论文 / 高优先级

Robot-Factored World Models via Robot Rendering

分类主题video / generative world models
Byungjun Kim, Taeksoo Kim, Hyunsoo Cha, Hanbyul Joo
high · 2026-07-24

为什么值得看 它把动作实现、机器人外形与运动学从视频世界模型中显式移出，改用可部署轨迹和渲染的机器人几何作为接口，使模型专注于预测接触和物体运动，并有望跨视角、跨机器人实体迁移。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

直接以动作指令为条件会让模型同时学习机器人控制实现，而以未来状态为条件又会泄漏应预测的交互结果。

02
方法

方法先用机器人的控制器和运动学将指令滚动为名义轨迹，再依据机器人描述文件渲染几何，并结合末端执行器深度与场景深度进行预测。

03
差异

模型不再把动作表示为向量，而是通过可见的机器人几何表达动作，并将机器人特定因素与场景响应分离。

04
证据

实验显示渲染接口优于向量条件基线，能在推理时泛化到未见过的机器人实体，并可将人类演示中的手部运动重定向为机器人操作视频。

摘要

该工作指出，机器人动作对未来观测的影响包含动作实现和场景响应两个过程，并提出用控制器与运动学生成的名义轨迹以及显式渲染的机器人几何，将机器人特定因素移出世界模型。模型结合相机感知的静态彩色与深度信息、机器人几何以及末端执行器和场景深度来学习物体响应；实验表明其优于向量条件基线，能泛化到未见机器人实体，并能通过重定向人类手部运动生成机器人操作视频。

Masked Diffusion Language Models are Strong and Steerable Text-Based World Models for Agentic RL

分类主题learned simulators
Darshan Deshpande
high · 2026-05-07

为什么值得看 它把文本环境中的状态转移建模为可控的世界模拟器，用双向掩码去噪同时约束工具模式、历史交互和预期结果，并在九类环境、二十三万九千条轨迹及三个未见环境上验证了更高的滚动多样性与最高四十七个百分点的迁移收益，为需要可扩展训练环境的智能体研究者提供了比单向生成更可控的选择。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 7）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

单向自回归世界模型难以同时遵守工具模式、历史状态和结果等全局相互依赖的锚点。

02
方法

作者将文本世界建模拆为初始状态、任务上下文、工具模式、领域规则和引导指令，并比较自回归语言模型与掩码扩散语言模型，再结合带确定性状态检查的群体相对策略优化训练。

03
差异

掩码扩散模型通过双向锚点感知去噪生成状态转移，而不是按从左到右的顺序逐词生成。

04
证据

在九个开源环境和十二个模型家族上，掩码扩散模型据称以相近推理延迟超过参数量四倍的语言模型，并在三个未见环境上取得最高四十七个百分点的绝对提升。

摘要

本文将面向智能体强化学习的文本世界建模形式化为可控的状态转移问题，并整理了覆盖九个开源环境、十二个前沿模型家族的二十三万九千零三条有依据的状态—动作轨迹。实验显示，掩码扩散语言模型借助双向锚点感知去噪，在连贯性、依据性和滚动多样性上优于参数量超过其四倍的自回归语言模型；结合带确定性状态检查的群体相对策略优化后，它们在科学世界、家庭世界和应用世界三个未见环境中无需环境专门微调即可为多种智能体骨干带来最高四十七个百分点的绝对提升。

SeerGuard: A Safety Framework for Mobile GUI Agents via World Model Prediction

分类主题learned simulators
Xue Yu, Bo Yuan, Pengshuai Yang, Kailin Zhao, Hong Hu, Junlan Feng
high · 2026-07-17

为什么值得看 它把世界模型从事后纠错工具变成执行前的安全过滤器，用语义下一状态预测联合评估界面操作后果，适合需要避免不可逆误操作的移动图形界面代理。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 26）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

移动图形界面代理可能因一次错误操作造成不可逆后果，而现有安全机制主要在执行后反应。

02
方法

系统通过多任务学习构建安全增强世界模型，同时预测语义下一状态并评估安全风险。

03
差异

它在指令级筛查之外，对代理提出的具体操作进行执行前的后果感知风险评估。

04
证据

在指定实验中，基于八十亿参数视觉语言模型的安全效用分数由零点一九一升至零点五九六，风险成本分数由零点三四七降至零点一三零。

摘要

论文提出面向移动图形界面代理的后果感知安全框架，通过执行前的指令级筛查和操作级风险评估来降低单次错误操作带来的安全风险。其核心是用多任务学习构建安全增强世界模型，联合进行语义下一状态预测与安全风险评估；实验表明，该方法能跨不同移动图形界面代理泛化，并在给定模型和评估设置下提升安全效用、降低风险成本。

主题planning with world models

论文 / 高优先级

Masked Visual Actions for Unified World Modeling

分类主题planning with world models
Hadi Alzayer, Wenlong Huang, Haonan Chen, Christopher Luey, Lvmin Zhang, Maneesh Agrawala et al.
high · 2026-07-21

为什么值得看 它让同一个视觉世界模型既能根据机器人轨迹预测场景变化，又能根据目标物体轨迹反推机器人动作，并已用于真实执行结果评估、候选未来排序和逆向建模，从而减少为不同机器人任务分别设计动作接口的需要。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 8）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

视频模型掌握了丰富的视觉交互先验，却缺少与物理操控动作对齐的控制表达方式。

02
方法

方法把任意实体的部分可见像素轨迹作为动作输入，并用真实视频和仿真中的十五小时掩码样本微调单一模型。

03
差异

机器人运动轨迹使模型执行前向动力学预测，而目标物体轨迹则使模型生成相符的机器人运动。

04
证据

摘要

方法解读
01
问题

单向自回归世界模型难以同时遵守工具模式、历史状态和结果等全局相互依赖的锚点。

02
方法

作者将文本世界建模拆为初始状态、任务上下文、工具模式、领域规则和引导指令，并比较自回归语言模型与掩码扩散语言模型，再结合带确定性状态检查的群体相对策略优化训练。

03
差异

掩码扩散模型通过双向锚点感知去噪生成状态转移，而不是按从左到右的顺序逐词生成。

04
证据

在九个开源环境和十二个模型家族上，掩码扩散模型据称以相近推理延迟超过参数量四倍的语言模型，并在三个未见环境上取得最高四十七个百分点的绝对提升。

摘要

本文将面向智能体强化学习的文本世界建模形式化为可控的状态转移问题，并整理了覆盖九个开源环境、十二个前沿模型家族的二十三万九千零三条有依据的状态—动作轨迹。实验显示，掩码扩散语言模型借助双向锚点感知去噪，在连贯性、依据性和滚动多样性上优于参数量超过其四倍的自回归语言模型；结合带确定性状态检查的群体相对策略优化后，它们在科学世界、家庭世界和应用世界三个未见环境中无需环境专门微调即可为多种智能体骨干带来最高四十七个百分点的绝对提升。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 26）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

移动图形界面代理可能因一次错误操作造成不可逆后果，而现有安全机制主要在执行后反应。

02
方法

系统通过多任务学习构建安全增强世界模型，同时预测语义下一状态并评估安全风险。

03
差异

它在指令级筛查之外，对代理提出的具体操作进行执行前的后果感知风险评估。

04
证据

在指定实验中，基于八十亿参数视觉语言模型的安全效用分数由零点一九一升至零点五九六，风险成本分数由零点三四七降至零点一三零。

摘要

论文提出面向移动图形界面代理的后果感知安全框架，通过执行前的指令级筛查和操作级风险评估来降低单次错误操作带来的安全风险。其核心是用多任务学习构建安全增强世界模型，联合进行语义下一状态预测与安全风险评估；实验表明，该方法能跨不同移动图形界面代理泛化，并在给定模型和评估设置下提升安全效用、降低风险成本。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 8）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

视频模型掌握了丰富的视觉交互先验，却缺少与物理操控动作对齐的控制表达方式。

02
方法

方法把任意实体的部分可见像素轨迹作为动作输入，并用真实视频和仿真中的十五小时掩码样本微调单一模型。

03
差异

机器人运动轨迹使模型执行前向动力学预测，而目标物体轨迹则使模型生成相符的机器人运动。

04
证据

摘要声称该模型在多种场景和机器人形态上具备较强的视觉保真度与可控性，并支持策略评估、基于模型的规划和逆向建模。

摘要

视频模型学习了视觉世界运动、交互和接触响应的丰富先验，但需要一种既贴合视觉表征又扎根于物理操控的动作接口。本文引入掩码视觉动作，以任意实体的部分显露轨迹表示动作；显露机器人运动时模型预测场景响应，显露目标物体运动时模型生成相符的机器人行为，并声称仅用真实视频和仿真中的十五小时样本微调，就能在多种场景和机器人形态上支持视觉预测、规划评估与逆向建模。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

论文研究在非线性观测和动作变化受限时，受控潜变量预测何时能够识别真实状态及其动作条件转移。

02
方法

作者在状态依赖的高斯行为策略与高斯潜状态假设下，建立联合可识别性理论并分析联合嵌入预测架构目标的全局及近似最优解。

03
差异

分析将表示可识别性归因于可预测信号的谱分离，将转移可识别性归因于条件动作变化的非退化性，并进一步刻画弱激励动作方向上的反事实风险。

04
证据

理论证明满足两项条件时可恢复潜状态和受控转移至正交变换，并通过非线性观测、不同策略及潜空间目标规划实验进行验证。

摘要

论文研究受控世界模型在高维观测下何时能够同时识别潜在状态和受控动力学，重点分析联合嵌入预测架构在非线性观测及动作条件变化有限时面临的状态演化与动作效应混淆。作者在状态依赖的高斯行为策略和高斯潜状态假设下，证明可预测信号的谱分离与非退化的条件动作变化分别决定表示和转移的可识别性，并给出近似优化下的定量界及动作覆盖不足导致的反事实误差放大结果；实验支持这些理论并展示其对转移识别、反事实预测和目标条件潜空间规划的影响。
